{{Quote|So you spoke with the Spiderclan Matron and the secret they guard so heavily is the location of their Queen Mother?|[[Izaryx]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EHtS" />}}
The '''Breeding Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:EHtS" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the cave was inhabited by a giant [[gaping spider]] domesticated by the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] of the [[Spiderclan/Legends|Spiderclan]] as their Queen Mother.<ref name="SWG:THP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Hunting Party|Dathomir}}</ref>
[[File:Breeding_Cave_interior.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The interior of the cave.]]
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Breeding Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EHtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Breeding Cave was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced upon the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
